title.en: Anthropic presses ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO at a lower valuation

summary.zh: Anthropic 仍计划上市，估值区间 1.25 万亿至 1.75 万亿美元，低于预期的 2 万亿，拟募资 800 亿至 1000 亿美元。
summary.en: Anthropic is pressing ahead with its IPO at a $1.25–1.75 trillion valuation, below the hoped-for $2 trillion, aiming to raise $80–100 billion.

why.zh: AI 头部公司上市将重塑行业资本格局。
why.en: A frontier-lab IPO would reshape AI capital markets.

sources.title: Anthropic pushes ahead with pre-Thanksgiving IPO despite tech selloff, accepts lower valuation

title.zh: OpenAI 新一轮融资再进 110 亿美元，估值 1.25 万亿美元
title.en: OpenAI raises another $11B at a $1.25 trillion valuation

summary.zh: OpenAI 据报道首批募得 110 亿美元，估值 1.25 万亿美元，全轮可能增至 200 亿美元，尚未交割。
summary.en: OpenAI has reportedly raised $11 billion as the first tranche of a round valuing it at $1.25 trillion; the full round could reach $20 billion and has not closed.

why.zh: 显示 AI 实验室融资规模仍在攀升。
why.en: Shows AI-lab fundraising still scaling up.

sources.title: OpenAI lands an $11 billion funding round, but has to court dentists for more capital
OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
OpenAI valued at $1.25 trillion, as rival Anthropic nears its IPO

title.zh: METR 报告：Anthropic 用 AI 加速 AI 研发，模型进步速度约为一年前的两倍
title.en: METR report: Anthropic automating AI development, models improving about twice as fast

summary.zh: The Verge 报道称，Anthropic 用 AI 构建更强的 AI，其模型进步速度约为一年前的两倍，且几乎没有放缓迹象，引发研究者担忧。
summary.en: The Verge reports Anthropic is using AI to build more powerful AI, with models improving roughly twice as fast as a year ago and little sign of slowing, which alarms researchers.

why.zh: AI 自我加速研发是安全与治理讨论的核心问题。
why.en: AI-accelerated AI R&D is central to safety and governance debates.

sources.title: Why a new report on Anthropic automating AI development is alarming researchers
[AINews] Inkling 2 Small: 17A-594B trained in 68 hours on 12T tokens, beating Muse Spark

title.zh: Ricursive 发布 Ripple-65B Preview：Apache 2.0 开源美国模型
title.en: Ricursive releases Ripple-65B Preview, an Apache 2.0 open US model

summary.zh: Ricursive Intelligence 发布 650 亿参数开源权重模型 Ripple-65B Preview，称其在 TerminalBench 上取得美国开源模型最高分。
summary.en: Ricursive Intelligence released the 65B open-weight Ripple-65B Preview, which it says tops open-source US models on TerminalBench.

why.zh: 给出完全宽松许可的开源智能体编码模型新选择。
why.en: A new permissively licensed open model for agentic coding.

sources.title: Ripple-65B Preview delivers strong agentic coding results as a fully Apache 2.0 open US model

title.zh: 开源与闭源模型的网络攻击能力差距持续缩小
title.en: The open–closed gap in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking

summary.zh: Vals AI 基准中，GPT-6 Sol Daybreak 在模拟企业网络中达成 80.8% 攻击目标，开源权重的 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 达 72.8%。
summary.en: In the Vals AI benchmark, GPT-6 Sol Daybreak hits 80.8% of attack objectives in simulated corporate networks while open-weight DeepSeek V4.1 Flash reaches 72.8%.

why.zh: 开源模型的攻击能力逼近闭源，影响防御与监管思路。
why.en: Open models closing in on closed ones in offensive ability affects defense and policy.

sources.title: The gap between open and closed AI models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking

title.zh: Perplexity 推出常驻 AI 智能体 Teammates

summary.zh: Teammates 在各自的虚拟机上持续推进项目，需要每月 200 美元的 Max 套餐，价格高于同类产品。
summary.en: Teammates work on ongoing projects on their own virtual machines and require the $200/month Max plan, well above similar offerings.

why.zh: 常驻云端智能体成为各家产品的新方向。
why.en: Always-on cloud agents are becoming a product battleground.

sources.title: Perplexity now has its own always-on AI agent

title.zh: 研究：AI 审计员能抓住多数智能体违规，但误报泛滥
title.en: Study: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms

summary.zh: Anthropic 研究员 Andy Hall 的研究显示，GPT-5 能发现约 98% 的奖励投机案例，但更详尽的审计会产生大量误报。
summary.en: A study by Anthropic researcher Andy Hall finds GPT-5 caught about 98% of reward-hacking cases, but more exhaustive auditing floods reviewers with false alarms.

why.zh: 为智能体监督的可行性与成本提供数据。
why.en: Gives data on the feasibility and cost of agent oversight.

sources.title: AI auditors catch most agent misbehavior but flood reviewers with false alarms, new study finds

title.zh: 九个 AI 智能体挑战国家实验室开放问题，无一达到专家标准
title.en: Nine AI agents tackle national-lab open questions; none meets the experts’ bar

summary.zh: “Into the Unknown”基准让九个智能体研究美国国家实验室的开放问题，135 份提交没有一份满足全部要求。
summary.en: The “Into the Unknown” benchmark had nine agents tackle open questions from U.S. national labs; none of 135 submissions met all requirements.

why.zh: 说明自主科研智能体距离专家水平仍有差距。
why.en: Shows autonomous research agents still fall short of expert level.

sources.title: Nine AI agents tried autonomous research on open questions from US national labs and none passed the experts' bar

title.zh: Nous Research：某些中国模型的政治宣传只是“薄薄一层”，微调即可去除
title.en: Nous Research: propaganda in some Chinese models is a thin layer fine-tuning can strip

summary.zh: Nous 重训阿里 Qwen3.8-27B 得到 Arete-27B，宣传倾向率从 22% 降至不足 1%，通用能力基本保持。
summary.en: Nous retrained Alibaba’s Qwen3.8-27B into Arete-27B, cutting the propaganda rate from 22% to under 1% while largely keeping general capability.

why.zh: 影响对开源模型对齐与偏见可控性的判断。
why.en: Bears on how controllable bias and alignment are in open models.

sources.title: State propaganda in some Chinese AI models is only "a thin layer" that fine-tuning can strip away

title.zh: Meta 为 Muse 推出 Spaces，让智能体生成定制的类应用界面
title.en: Meta adds Spaces to Muse, letting the agent build custom app-like views

summary.zh: Muse 的 Spaces 可让 AI 助手构建购物中心、学校仪表盘、音乐追踪等定制的类应用体验。
summary.en: Muse’s Spaces lets the assistant build custom app-like experiences such as a shopping hub, school dashboard or music tracker.

why.zh: 助手从对话走向按需生成界面。
why.en: Assistants are moving from chat to generating interfaces on demand.

sources.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent
Meta’s Muse AI can create custom ‘spaces’ for the version of the app you need right now

title.zh: Ramp 数据：AI 支出趋于停滞，而 Anthropic 临近 IPO
title.en: Ramp data: AI spending stalls as Anthropic nears its IPO

summary.zh: Ramp 数据显示 AI 使用量仍在攀升但支出停滞，大客户的降价与成本控制可能挑战投资者对 AI 高增长的假设。
summary.en: Ramp data shows AI usage still climbing but spending stalled; price cuts and cost controls among top spenders could challenge hypergrowth assumptions.

why.zh: 为 AI 估值与需求判断提供反向信号。
why.en: A counter-signal for AI valuation and demand narratives.

sources.title: Ramp data shows AI spending stalling just as Anthropic nears its IPO
